description: First anchor nearest soma, then greedily maximize newly covered sites, using farthest cable-path distance to break ties; after full coverage, use farthest-point anchors; each branch receives its 100 nearest unique sites. Ties use site ID. E/I signs remain attached to physical site IDs.
capacity_note: Declared dimensions and trainable parameter count unchanged. Correcting empty branches increases effective valid slots from 3800 to 4500; spatial ordering and restored branch utilization are not separately identified.
